lemma posLog_norm_sum_le {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → E) :
    log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖ := by
  have key : ∀ {x y : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ y → log⁺ x ≤ log⁺ y := fun hx hxy ↦
    monotoneOn_posLog hx (hx.trans hxy) hxy
  calc log⁺ ‖∑ t ∈ s, f t‖
  _ ≤ log⁺ (∑ t ∈ s, ‖f t‖) := key (norm_nonneg _) (norm_sum_le s f)
  _ ≤ log s.card + ∑ t ∈ s, log⁺ ‖f t‖ := posLog_sum s (‖f ·‖)
